{{ill|Aki Shrine|ja|阿紀神社}} is a {{ill|Moto-Ise Shrines|ja|元伊勢|lt=Motoise shrine}}

Moto-Ise Shrines are {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}} that used to host Amaterasu before she was moved to [[Ise Grand Shrine|Ise Jingu]]. The first one was {{ill|Ōmiwa Shrine|abstract|Q705542|ar|معبد أوميوا|fa|معبد اومیوا|fr|Ōmiwa-jinja|id|Kuil Ōmiwa|ja|大神神社|la|Templum Ōmiwa|my|အိုးမိဝကျောင်းတော်|ru|Оомива-дзиндзя|simple|Ōmiwa Shrine|tok|tomo sewi Omiwa|zh|大神神社|qid=Q705542}} ({{ill|Ōmiwa Shrine|abstract|Q705542|ar|معبد أوميوا|fa|معبد اومیوا|fr|Ōmiwa-jinja|id|Kuil Ōmiwa|ja|大神神社|la|Templum Ōmiwa|my|အိုးမိဝကျောင်းတော်|ru|Оомива-дзиндзя|simple|Ōmiwa Shrine|tok|tomo sewi Omiwa|zh|大神神社|qid=Q705542|lt=Ōmiwa Shrine}}).
